verses.text: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High Will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.textZh: 住在至高者隱密處的，必住在全能者的蔭下。

verses.text: I will say to the LORD, 'My refuge and my fortress, My God, in whom I trust!'
verses.textZh: 我要論到耶和華說：他是我的避難所，是我的山寨，是我的神，是我所倚靠的。

verses.text: For it is He who delivers you from the snare of the trapper And from the deadly pestilence.
verses.textZh: 他必救你脫離捕鳥人的網羅和毒害的瘟疫。

verses.text: He will cover you with His pinions, And under His wings you may seek refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and bulwark.
verses.textZh: 他必用自己的翎毛遮蔽你；你要投靠在他的翅膀底下；他的誠實是大小的盾牌。

verses.text: You will not be afraid of the terror by night, Or of the arrow that flies by day;
verses.textZh: 你必不怕黑夜的驚駭，或是白日飛的箭，

verses.text: Of the pestilence that stalks in darkness, Or of the destruction that lays waste at noon.
verses.textZh: 也不怕黑夜行的瘟疫，或是午間滅人的毒病。

verses.text: A thousand may fall at your side And ten thousand at your right hand, [But] it shall not approach you.
verses.textZh: 雖有千人仆倒在你旁邊，萬人仆倒在你右邊，這災卻不得臨近你。

verses.text: You will only look on with your eyes And see the recompense of the wicked.
verses.textZh: 你惟親眼觀看，見惡人遭報。

verses.text: For you have made the LORD, my refuge, [Even] the Most High, your dwelling place.
verses.textZh: 耶和華是我的避難所；你已將至高者當你的居所，

verses.text: No evil will befall you, Nor will any plague come near your tent.
verses.textZh: 禍患必不臨到你，災害也不挨近你的帳棚。

verses.text: For He will give His angels charge concerning you, To guard you in all your ways.
verses.textZh: 因他要為你吩咐他的使者，在你行的一切道路上保護你。

verses.text: They will bear you up in their hands, That you do not strike your foot against a stone.
verses.textZh: 他們要用手托著你，免得你的腳碰在石頭上。

verses.text: You will tread upon the lion and cobra, The young lion and the serpent you will trample down.
verses.textZh: 你要踹在獅子和虺蛇的身上，踐踏少壯獅子和大蛇。

verses.text: 'Because he has loved Me, therefore I will deliver him; I will set him [securely] on high, because he has known My name.
verses.textZh: 神說：因為他專心愛我，我就要搭救他；因為他知道我的名，我要把他安置在高處。

verses.text: 'He will call upon Me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble; I will rescue him and honor him.
verses.textZh: 他若求告我，我就應允他；他在急難中，我要與他同在；我要搭救他，使他尊貴。

verses.text: 'With a long life I will satisfy him And let him see My salvation.'
verses.textZh: 我要使他足享長壽，將我的救恩顯明給他。
